semantics.persistent: u applied at every optimizer step k=1..64: lr_k = snap_lr_k * exp(u)
semantics.pulse4_release: u applied only at optimizer steps k=1..4; k>=5 restores native lr_k = snap_lr_k; theta/m/v formed during intervention are RETAINED; m1=b1*m+(1-b1)*c and v1=b2*v+(1-b2)*c^2 are lr-independent, so post-release m/v evolution is identical to persistent arm given identical gradients
semantics.readouts: H in {4,16,64} from ONE 64-step nested trajectory per arm (not re-sampled per H)
semantics.paired_arms: all arms of a cell restore the identical full snapshot and use identical future stream (batch+dropout RNG); eval readouts wrapped in capture/restore RNG; eval runs in eval() mode and restores train()
semantics.horizon_consistency_requirement: pulse4_release(u) == persistent(u) at H=4 bitwise (both intervene steps 1..4 only)

sample.seed_selection_rule: fixed ascending order of available v0.7 bank training seeds, first 3
sample.checkpoint_rule: absolute optimizer steps registered in v0.7 bank; both exist, no substitution needed
sample.stream_selection_rule: new stream seeds 7500-7503 verified unused by all prior experiments (grep over research/ and frozen outputs)
sample.stress_case_rule: independent re-check of the 2 frozen A0T reversal cells on their original frozen stream; labeled STRESS, excluded from all main-sample statistics

readout.primary: V_eval (A0G frozen validation_split v_eval, eval_batch_size=8, mean loss)
readout.precision: bf16 autocast, native attention backend (frozen v07 config, identical to A0O/A0T/A0U)

budget.counting_rule: every optimizer step executed by smoke + main + stress + frozen-runner reference replays counts; evals/HVP/CPU counted separately in gpu_budget_log.json (wall time), hidden nowhere
budget.no_auto_expansion: checkpoint/seed/H/model/scan-density expansion forbidden; on overflow risk, stop and report

thresholds_frozen_before_results.crn: repeated native arm bitwise identical at all readouts (fail => stop and fix)
thresholds_frozen_before_results.frozen_runner_agreement: new-runner native endpoint L == a0q.run_channel_rollout(u=0) bitwise (fail => stop and fix)
thresholds_frozen_before_results.pulse_persistent_H4: pulse4_release(u) == persistent(u) at H=4 bitwise for each u: losses AND theta AND optimizer m/v/step (fail => stop and fix)
thresholds_frozen_before_results.release_semantics: post-release (H=16): pulse m/v DIVERGED from persistent m/v (any key; release != persistent continuation) AND pulse m/v CONTINUED from its own H=4 state (step counter +12, exp_avg moved, no None/reset) AND applied lr == snap native lr (fail => stop and fix)
thresholds_frozen_before_results.release_semantics_correction_note: 2026-09-20 smoke stage: original wording 'post-release m/v bitwise identical to persistent' encoded a physically impossible invariant (post-release theta paths differ => gradients differ => m/v differ from step 5 on). Corrected BEFORE any main/stress results, during the smoke stage whose purpose is exactly to catch such errors. The valid bitwise m/v identity lives at H=4. Original failing evidence preserved in runs/smoke_checks_attempt1.json (release_m_v_retained_H16=false).
thresholds_frozen_before_results.q_identifiability_rule: Q identifiable only if (i) Q_fd(a=0.05) and Q_fd(a=0.025) have the same sign, AND (ii) |Q| > max(|Q_dev - Q_audit|, |Q(0.05) - Q(0.025)|) where dev/audit are the two-stream class means; otherwise UNRESOLVED (never clipped to positive, no epsilon padding)
thresholds_frozen_before_results.q_positive_rule: interior minimum formula u*=-chi/Q only if Q identifiable AND Q>0; if Q<=0 compare boundary actions vs zero; if UNRESOLVED output no curvature conclusion
thresholds_frozen_before_results.dev_audit_rule: quadratic fit on dev streams ({-0.025,0,+0.025}) checked for extrapolation to +/-0.05 on dev; stream-out generalization checked separately on audit; the two checks are labeled separately and never treated as independent validations of each other
thresholds_frozen_before_results.v_grid_hindsight: V_grid uses full per-cell loss curves => hindsight upper bound, not deployable value; any action chosen from real future rollouts or V_eval labeled oracle/hindsight
thresholds_frozen_before_results.stream_stats_note: 3 seeds x 2 checkpoints x 4 streams = 24 cells; timepoints/streams are NOT independent seeds; all inferential stats labeled pilot/exploratory; seed is the only independent cluster (n=3)

local_quasi_stationarity: NOT_TESTED this round (smooth curves are not evidence)
